_meta.scoring_methodology: harsh — wired-not-GPU-tested max 5; mock-only max 6; stub max 2; constitutional novelty full credit only when runtime check is live
_meta.hardware: RTX 4060 Ti 16GB (Ada Lovelace, SM 8.9) — enables FP8 (d10), Triton kernels (d15). Blackwell SM10.0 NOT available — d12 FP4 is hardware-blocked, max achievable without upgrade: 5.
_meta.stop_condition: danteforge compete --check-all-nine exits 0 (or all non-hardware-blocked dims at 9+)

waves.name: Training Foundation
waves.rationale: SFT+QLoRA on real GPU unblocks d11/d13/d20/d10. GGUF export unblocks d30. Real server unblocks d26/d27/d28. All four are independent — max parallelism.

dimensions.name: SFT GPU-tested
dimensions.what_9_means: TRL SFTTrainer runs on RTX 4060 Ti 16GB with DOJO_REAL_GPU=1. Real loss curve logged. Model checkpoint saved. Evidence chain captures TRAIN_START/STEP/COMPLETE with Merkle root. Test: fine-tune a 1B-7B model with real data for ≥10 steps, check loss decreases, assert evidence chain is intact.

dimensions.name: QLoRA GPU-tested
dimensions.what_9_means: load_in_4bit + LoraConfig trains on RTX 4060 Ti 16GB. VRAM budget ≤ 14GB. Adapter saved. Evidence chain intact. Test: 7B model QLoRA, measure VRAM, assert adapter loads back.

dimensions.name: GGUF conversion
dimensions.what_9_means: dojo pack --to-gguf converts a trained HuggingFace model to Q4_K_M GGUF using llama.cpp convert scripts. Resulting GGUF is readable by llama.cpp. Constitutional passport ID embedded in GGUF metadata (key: dojo_passport_id). Test: convert 1B model, load with llama.cpp, verify passport metadata.

dimensions.name: Real OpenAI-compatible server
dimensions.what_9_means: dojo serve starts a real FastAPI server. /v1/chat/completions accepts OpenAI-format request, routes to a local model (llama.cpp or vLLM), returns SSE tokens. Test with openai Python client. Evidence emits SERVE_REQUEST_START/COMPLETE. Tested with 3 concurrent requests.

waves.name: Quantization + vLLM
waves.rationale: GPTQ/AWQ need real GPU (Wave 1 proves training works). vLLM is independent. Block quant already at 7, needs adversarial tests to reach 9.

dimensions.name: GPTQ real GPU
dimensions.what_9_means: AutoGPTQ quantizes a trained model to 4-bit on real GPU. GPTQ .safetensors saved. Quality gate (d13) fires: PPL measured vs FP16 baseline. Test: quantize 1B model, assert PPL delta < 15%.

dimensions.name: AWQ real GPU
dimensions.what_9_means: AutoAWQ quantizes a trained model to 4-bit on real GPU. AWQ .safetensors saved. F1 delta check fires. Test: quantize 1B model, assert F1 delta < 5pt vs FP16.

dimensions.name: Block quant precision floor
dimensions.what_9_means: BlockQuantizer enforces precision floor with adversarial test suite: floor violations from 5 different attack vectors (underflow, overflow, NaN, precision downcast, direct bypass). All raise BlockQuantizationError with evidence. Test: 5 adversarial tests all caught.

dimensions.name: vLLM paged attention
dimensions.what_9_means: vLLM backend wired into dojo serve --backend vllm. PagedAttention inference tested. Throughput measured. Evidence emits VLLM_SERVE_START/COMPLETE. Test: vLLM serves 3 concurrent requests, token throughput logged.

waves.name: GPU-unlocked Hardware Dims
waves.rationale: With Wave 1 done, d11/d13/d20/d09/d10 can all be validated on real RTX 4060 Ti (SM 8.9 = Ada Lovelace — FP8 is supported).

dimensions.name: BF16/FP16 GPU-tested
dimensions.what_9_means: SFT training run with torch_dtype=bfloat16 on RTX 4060 Ti. Loss logged. Evidence captures precision used. Mixed precision gradient scaler active. Test: BF16 training run completes, loss < FP32 baseline within 5%.

dimensions.name: Quant quality gate real
dimensions.what_9_means: QuantQualityRejected fires in a real quantization run where PPL delta > 15%. Test with GPTQ (d22 done) and AWQ (d23 done): run a bad quantization, assert gate fires with evidence. Run a good quantization, assert gate passes. Both paths covered.

dimensions.name: Idle daemon full credit
dimensions.what_9_means: dojo idle-train actually trains a model on real GPU when machine is idle. A real training loop runs (SFT, d16 done). Evidence shows IDLE_TRAIN_START + CHECKPOINT events with real loss values. Test: trigger idle state, start idle-train, verify 10 steps run, verify checkpoint saved.

dimensions.name: SM detection real hardware
dimensions.what_9_means: dojo detect runs on real RTX 4060 Ti. Returns SM=8.9, precision matrix shows FP8=supported, FP4=not_supported. Evidence emits DETECT_HARDWARE with real torch.cuda.get_device_capability() output. Test: assert SM version is real float from CUDA, not mock.

dimensions.name: FP8 training (SM>=8.9, Ada)
dimensions.what_9_means: RTX 4060 Ti IS Ada Lovelace (SM 8.9) — FP8 IS achievable. Wire TransformerEngine FP8 training (use_fp8=True via transformer_engine or torchao FP8). Training run with FP8 completes on RTX 4060 Ti. SM guard passes. Evidence emits FP8_TRAINING_START/STEP. Test: FP8 fine-tune of 1B model, loss logged, VRAM vs BF16 delta reported.

waves.name: Serving Streams (live inference loop)
waves.rationale: d29 real server (Wave 1) + d24/d30 GGUF local runner now exist. d26/d27/d28 streaming governors can be wired into a real inference loop.

dimensions.name: Local model runner (GGUF/llama.cpp)
dimensions.what_9_means: dojo run or dojo serve --backend llama.cpp loads a GGUF model locally. Tokens stream. Zero cloud calls. Evidence emits LOCAL_SERVE_START/TOKEN_STREAM/COMPLETE. Test: load a Q4_K_M GGUF on RTX 4060 Ti, generate 100 tokens, assert tokens correct, assert no network calls.

dimensions.name: VRAM streaming (live)
dimensions.what_9_means: WeightStreamer governs real inference. At most 1 layer in VRAM at a time during a real generation pass. Tested against a model larger than VRAM (force layer-by-layer streaming). SovereignHalt fires on violation. Evidence emits LAYER_LOAD/LAYER_EVICT per step. Test: generate 50 tokens with layer streaming active, VRAM never exceeds 1-layer budget.

dimensions.name: KV-cache streaming (live)
dimensions.what_9_means: KVCacheStreamer evicts pages during a real generation pass when capacity cap is hit. Evidence emits KV_PAGE_EVICT with constitutional reason. Tested under real token generation pressure. Test: generate 512 tokens with KV cap set to 128 tokens, assert eviction events fired, no OOM.

dimensions.name: Prefetch governor (live)
dimensions.what_9_means: PrefetchGovernor limits lookahead to ≤16 layers during real inference. Tested under real generation. SovereignHalt fires when lookahead > 16 is attempted. Evidence emits PREFETCH_GOVERNED. Test: set lookahead=20, assert SovereignHalt, try lookahead=8, assert passes.

waves.name: Routing + Cost + Revocation
waves.rationale: All three routing dims (d32/d35/d36) need real provider calls. d08 needs a live revocation endpoint — build a minimal DanteDojo revocation server or wire the check against a real URL.

dimensions.name: Multi-provider routing (real calls)
dimensions.what_9_means: Router dispatch() makes real API calls to ≥3 providers: (1) local Ollama, (2) a cloud provider (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic), (3) the local DanteDojo server. Routing decision logged in evidence. Cost comparison present. Test: route same prompt to all 3, assert correct provider selected per RoutingPolicy, evidence emits ROUTE_DISPATCHED.

dimensions.name: Cost tracking real oracle
dimensions.what_9_means: Per-token cost oracle uses a provider price table (at minimum: OpenAI pricing + Anthropic pricing + local=0). max_cost_usd enforced: request above budget raises RoutingBudgetExceeded with evidence. Per-request cost logged to evidence chain with USD amount. Test: set max_cost=0.001, route a 1000-token request, assert budget enforcement fires.

dimensions.name: Fallback-on-unavailable (live)
dimensions.what_9_means: Tested against a real unavailable provider: start a route to a dead endpoint, assert fallback triggers correctly when fallback_on_unavailable=True, assert RoutingProviderUnavailable raised when False. Evidence emits ROUTE_FALLBACK. Test: use a down provider URL, assert both behaviors.

dimensions.name: Sovereign revocation (live check)
dimensions.what_9_means: At model load time, DanteDojo HTTP-GETs the revocation_url from ConstitutionalPassport. If response is {revoked: true}, raises PassportRevoked and blocks inference. Build a minimal dojo revoke-server sub-command (serve the revocation JSON) OR wire against a static HTTP endpoint. Test: (1) serve revoked=false, load model → succeeds. (2) serve revoked=true, load model → PassportRevoked raised. Evidence emits REVOCATION_CHECKED.

waves.name: Experiment Tracking (no GPU needed)
waves.rationale: cat_h is the weakest category at 27.5%. All 4 dims are pure Python. W&B + comparison leaderboard are free wins.

dimensions.name: MLflow production
dimensions.what_9_means: MLflow tracking server integration is production-hardened. start_run(), log_param(), log_metric(), log_artifact() all work against a real MLflow server (not just in-memory). Run URI returned and storable. Evidence emits EXPERIMENT_RUN_LOGGED. Test: spin up mlflow server in CI, run training, assert run appears in server.

dimensions.name: Run logging (params/metrics/artifacts)
dimensions.what_9_means: Training hyperparams (lr, batch_size, model, epochs), loss curve (step-level), and model artifact path all logged. Evidence chain captures PARAMS_LOGGED/METRICS_LOGGED/ARTIFACT_LOGGED. Test: run training with MLflow active, query API, assert all 3 types present.

dimensions.name: Experiment comparison + leaderboard
dimensions.what_9_means: dojo experiment compare returns a ranked table of runs sorted by F1 or eval loss. Best checkpoint highlighted. Exportable as JSON. Test: create 3 runs with different F1 scores, assert compare returns correct rank order.

dimensions.name: W&B + Neptune/alt tracker
dimensions.what_9_means: W&B integration via wandb.init() callback wired into training loop. dojo train --tracker wandb logs run to W&B. Alternative (Neptune or Comet) also supported via --tracker flag. Test: mock wandb server, assert log_param/metric called. Constitutional note: tracker is pluggable but evidence chain (d02) remains sovereign regardless of tracker.

waves.name: Near-9s + Ecosystem (6 agents — largest wave)
waves.rationale: Six dimensions clustered in the 7-8 range, all no-GPU, all independent. Ship them in one wave with 6 agents.

dimensions.name: Judge agreement gate ≥80%
dimensions.what_9_means: 3 distinct judge models run (e.g. GPT-4, Claude Haiku, Gemini Flash). Agreement calculated pairwise. JudgeDriftError fires when agreement < 80% across all 3 pairs. Evidence emits JUDGE_AGREEMENT with scores from each judge. Test: mock all 3 judges with controlled disagreement, assert gate fires at <80%.

dimensions.name: Synthetic eval fallback
dimensions.what_9_means: Synthetic tasks cover all 8 canonical benchmarks: MMLU (5-shot), HellaSwag (10-shot), ARC-Challenge (25-shot), WinoGrande (5-shot), TruthfulQA (0-shot), BoolQ (0-shot), GSM8K (8-shot), LAMBADA (0-shot). Synthetic variants match format and few-shot structure. Test: run with lm-eval mocked as unavailable, assert all 8 synthetic tasks run, scores returned.

dimensions.name: Contamination detection real corpus
dimensions.what_9_means: PackContaminationDetected tested against a real multi-GB dataset (HuggingFace dataset, ≥1M examples). Hash-check completes in < 60s via streaming. Evidence emits CONTAMINATION_CHECKED with corpus size and match count. Test: inject 10 known eval-gold items into training corpus, assert all 10 detected.

dimensions.name: Model registry (dojo:// URI)
dimensions.what_9_means: Full CRUD: register, lookup, list, delete, version. dojo:// URIs are resolvable to artifact paths. Versioning: multiple versions of same model name stored and selectable (dojo://my-model:v2). Test: register model v1 + v2, lookup v1 returns correct path, list shows both, delete v1 succeeds.

dimensions.name: Pack import + provenance chain
dimensions.what_9_means: Full provenance chain: pack import validates signature, checks license (d48), records provenance hash into evidence chain. Pack hash is recorded at import time. Test: import a real HuggingFace dataset as a pack, assert signature check passes, assert provenance in evidence chain, assert PackSchemaInvalid on malformed pack.

dimensions.name: License validation (allows_derived_ft)
dimensions.what_9_means: All license check paths tested: Apache-2.0 (allows_derived_ft=True), Llama Community License (allows_derived_ft=True with attribution), CC-BY-NC (allows_derived_ft=False → blocked). LicenseViolation raised with specific license name. Test: 3 license scenarios, assert correct pass/block behavior, assert evidence emits LICENSE_CHECKED.

waves.name: CLI + PyPI + Ecosystem
waves.rationale: d49 CLI completeness needs end-to-end smoke test. d50 PyPI requires publishing. d21 refinement if not fully green.

dimensions.name: CLI completeness + ergonomics
dimensions.what_9_means: All 12 CLI commands (detect, idle-train, train, serve, eval, promote, pack, registry, experiment, evidence, stream, version) smoke-tested end-to-end with DOJO_REAL_GPU=0 (mock mode). --help works for all sub-commands. dojo --version returns correct semver. Test: CI runs all 12 dojo <cmd> --help without error.

dimensions.name: PyPI + docs + community
dimensions.what_9_means: pip install dantedojo works. Versioned docs at a public URL. README with quickstart. GitHub Actions CI badge on README. Test: wheel builds cleanly, twine check passes, docs build with mkdocs/sphinx. Note: community is organic but PyPI + docs + CI = 9.

dimensions.name: Contamination detection — fallback refinement
dimensions.what_9_means: Retry if Wave 7 didn't reach 9. Focus on streaming large-corpus performance and evidence completeness.

waves.name: Triton Kernels + Custom CUDA (high effort stretch)
waves.rationale: d15 custom CUDA/Triton kernels. RTX 4060 Ti (SM 8.9) supports Triton. This wave is high effort — schedule after all other dims are green.

dimensions.name: Custom Triton/CUDA kernels for QLoRA
dimensions.what_9_means: Implement ≥2 custom Triton kernels: (1) fused dequant+matmul for 4-bit base model forward pass, (2) custom BF16 attention kernel. Benchmarked on RTX 4060 Ti: ≥20% throughput improvement vs HF TRL baseline on QLoRA SFT. Evidence emits KERNEL_LOADED with kernel name and speedup ratio. Test: benchmark 100 training steps with/without kernel, assert ≥20% speedup.

waves.name: Blackwell FP4 — Hardware Upgrade Required
waves.rationale: d12 requires SM10.0 (Blackwell). RTX 4060 Ti is SM 8.9. Cannot reach 9 without hardware upgrade. Max achievable on current HW: 5.

dimensions.name: FP4 training (Blackwell SM10.0)
dimensions.what_9_means: N/A on current hardware. To reach 9: requires RTX 5080/5090 or H200 (SM10.0). To reach 5: complete SM10.0 guard, FP4 training path wired, PrecisionUnsupported raised on SM<10.0 with test.
